items.title: Booking: proposal, authorization, order, payment
done: 23 of 30 actions ran at this point. New: create_proposal, get_proposal, respond_to_proposal, grant_authorization, revoke_authorization, list_authorizations, create_order, pay_order, get_order, list_orders, update_order_services. A proposal fixes each traveller's total: fare plus seat and bag fees. A new proposal supersedes the old one
Consent is enforced in the world: single use, bound to a digest of the proposal or order, with a ceiling, an expiry and revocation; every passenger must consent, even at zero
Ticketing and charging happen in one commit. Held orders take the seats for 24 hours and are cancelled by an event if unpaid
Inventory moves: seats sold or held raise later prices, and an offer is priced again at order time
Seats and bags with their fees: free middle seats on the basic fare, a free bag for elite members, paid extra-legroom seats

items.title: Code review, round 1: fifteen defects fixed
done: An independent code review of the kernel and the booking flow found 15 defects. All 15 were reproduced, accepted and fixed

Kernel: waiting now happens before a handler's transaction, so a refused call undoes only its own changes. Handlers and events cannot nest calls or move the clock. A scripted seat cannot wait inside its event
Kernel: a refusal that lands exactly on the observation end closes the episode. A malformed call is logged as it came and replays. The time cost of a call is exact
Sealed record: verification compares the log, both digests and the complete final state. A scorer reads the replayed state, never the stored one

Booking: the new action execute_proposal tickets every order of a proposal in one commit, at the proposal's amounts, with each payer charged exactly the agreed share. One payer can now fund several orders
A fare that moved makes the old proposal unexecutable. Before, consent for the old fare could pay the new one
Sales close 60 minutes before departure. An offer cannot be refreshed past that point
A seat belongs to one passenger. An order's seat table is replaced in one step, so a swap works and a doubled seat is refused. A repeated bag entry is refused instead of charged twice
Scripted traveller: the budget covers the whole episode, it rejects what it cannot check, and it keeps no memory
Interface version 0.3: 31 actions, 24 run. create_order is gone; hold_order only holds

One long session of 48 calls, 16 of them refused, with five rules checked after every call: seats, inventory, money, consent, and plans carried out as written
Fees in that session are checked against a table written out in the test, not against the code that charges them
A sealed record with any single change is rejected: one log entry, the final state, either digest, or a dropped refusal

Holding seats for a proposal does not use the proposal up, so an agent can still book the same plan twice. This is left as an agent error
